verified: RelayOne uses an OpenAI Images-compatible generations endpoint.
The default customer endpoint is https://aiapi.aiqji.cn/v1.
The default image model is gpt-image-2.
The MCP keeps both URL and b64_json fields in the saved response JSON.
notVerified: Available models and per-account limits are checked by the live RelayOne account.

parameters.name: Model
parameters.note: Defaults to gpt-image-2; use a model returned by the account's /models endpoint.

parameters.name: Size
parameters.note: Use a supported widthxheight value such as 1024x1024.

parameters.name: Count
parameters.note: The provider or account may impose a lower maximum.

parameters.name: Response format
parameters.note: Choose url or b64_json. Both are preserved in the saved response JSON.
